prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Shi Xie from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the long-reigning lord of Jiao province in the far south. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: scholarly rule, southern splendor, tropical silks.

World (fixed): year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Character: a small oval face, naturally open honey-gold eyes, curved brows, a neat nose and softly full lips; bronze-brown skin; a sculptural ink-blue high ponytail with two short cheek-framing locks; deep ink-blue hair. A warm, thoughtful sovereign expression. Voluptuous adult feminine proportions, balanced natural limbs.

Costume: a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape. the halo and waist plates unfold as concentric mechanical lotus petals with readable hinges and gold rimmed armor.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a southern lacquered fan, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings.

Costume colours (ours): tropical emerald, lotus pink, lacquer red and gold.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Rank (fixed): she is a ruler — her costume must read her sovereign rank at first glance: layered, richly ornate and regal, with flagship-card detail, fine engraving and jewellery, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Pose and setting: standing front-facing with her mechanical energy fan open beside her hip and her free hand relaxed. an asteroid fortress observation deck above a bright violet nebula.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers. No other person or creature. No text, logo, watermark or border. Far-future setting only, no traditional East-Asian architecture, pagodas, tiled roofs or hanzi.
